answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring escalating bonds that bridge funding-linked identities: first costs 10 POA, second 25, third 50, rising to 400 for the eighth. Bonds lock 10 epochs; any proven clone slashes the whole cluster. An attacker needs over 1500 POA locked plus audit risk to farm 15 fakes, while honest agents pay once. Juniper random audits sample 8% of bonds daily, and walnut vouchers provide secondary confirmation to catch shared-source clusters cheaply.
